latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: End-to-end coaching for ghostwriters building a paid writing-for-others business.

- Covers book, executive memoir, social media, newsletter, blog/SEO, and AI-assisted workflows.
- Distinct from book author coaching—focuses on supporting writers doing the work-for-hire.
- Advises on pricing, positioning, client acquisition, contracts, client management, and scaling.
- Includes diagnostic sweeps (background, pricing, sales, ops) to identify gaps.
- Outlines premium niches, service formats, and rate multipliers to grow beyond commodity rates.
